name: THE HOTEL CLERK
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor before the desk's left end (errata 91 C).
note: THE HOTEL CLERK, behind his desk with the register open before him. No document describes him; doc 27 gives his voice, and he is drawn as a fussy desk clerk of the period (errata 91 B): five poses on magenta against Thad (room-18 operation 3), cut at the desk top by tools/art/room18-clerk.py, the register a plane in front of him. BEHIND THE DESK: `y` is the cut row. Present in every act.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for the clerk.

sprite.frameNote: 0 hands on the register's pages, reading · 1 breath (derived) · 2 writing in it · 3 looking up over his spectacles. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77). The drawing's fifth pose (meant as turning the register round) came back as two raised fists beside the book and is not used.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master by cast-unify operation 16 (reference/cast-unify-14.txt), against a picture of the last attempt in this room; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge (tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py --grid 1), registered on the head and on the bottom row (tools/art/bust-register.py --bottom), head matched to the drawing it replaces.
sprite.waistOnNote: The plate row the figure's waist ends on: the register's far edge (y 410), which lies in front of his whole torso (the register spans x 1142-1272; the counter's back edge behind it is y 404). His hands rest on its pages, the pen's nib on the left page. Held by tests/counter-surface.test.mjs against the plate.

clipNote: No clip plane: the register (plane 1) lies forward of where his waist ends, and his hands rest on it.
